name: Traversal
summary: Where an actor may go and what it costs over the world's authored link graph (walk, climb, swim, jump, ride, boat), fast travel that lives through the journey's world time, and bodies seated on the paving rather than the navmesh.

assistant.summary: TraversalPlanner and FastTravelDirector (src/game-engine/logic/) decide over location atoms and the authored link graph; the engine answers the one geometric question, carries each move out, advances its clock through a journey's steps, and seats bodies on the drawn ground with src/ground-seating/.
notes: Author new ways across in WorldIR.traversal (links, costs, requirements); a new mode needs no code.
A climb or a swim is charged to the shared stamina meter; never keep a second traversal meter.
Fast travel advances the world clock in the plan's steps, in order, before the arrival: a schedule inside the journey runs.
Ground seating keeps no state in a save: a load seats every body at once.
Slope limit and step-up are the character controller's (U87(8)); they are not core parameters.
doNot: Stream positions or per-frame movement into core: report the arrival only.
Offer a fast-travel destination the actor could not walk to, or jump the clock in one advance.
